name: Lamikhai

abilities.name: Lunging Bite
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Stomp Down
abilities.description: Lamikhai climbs on its hind legs before crashing down with all its weight on you, dealing massive physical damage. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Rain of Fire
abilities.description: Valinna summons a rain of fire at a location in the arena, indicated by a large circular AoE, dealing continuous high flame damage.

abilities.name: Summon Spiders
abilities.description: Lamikhai will ocassionally summon weaker spiders from the ceiling to come assist in the fight.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: At 75% health, Lamikhai starts glowing red and greatly increases its damage output. You must lure Lamikhai to a ring of ice that Mazandi summons in the arena to freeze Lamikhai and remove this effect and give you an attack window while Lamikhai remains frozen solid.

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.description: At 50% health, Lamikhai escapes its arena. It will only appear later during the fight against Valinna when she also reaches 50% health, at which point both bosses join forces against you.

abilities.name: Summon Entrangler
abilities.description: In the second arena, Lamikhai periodically summons an Ensnaring Spider.

summary: Lamikhai is a giant Daedric spider and the third boss of Scrivener's Hall.
